## README.md
> **This dataset has moved.** It is now published, updated and extended as [Spain Madrid Crop fields](https://source.coop/ftw/harmonized-field-data/es_md) in the [Harmonized Field Boundary Data](https://source.coop/ftw/harmonized-field-data) catalog. The files here are no longer updated.

# Field boundaries for Spain Comunidad de Madrid

Provides 631861 official field boundaries from Spain Comunidad de Madrid.
It has been converted to a fiboa GeoParquet file from data obtained from Comunidad de Madrid.

- **Source Data Provider:** [Comunidad de Madrid](https://www.comunidad.madrid/)
- **Converted by:** Ivor Bosloper
- **License:** [No Limitations to public access](https://inspire.ec.europa.eu/metadata-codelist/LimitationsOnPublicAccess/noLimitations) as documented at source https://idem.comunidad.madrid/catalogocartografia/srv/spa/catalog.search#/metadata/spacm_sigpac
- **Projection:** EPSG:4258 (ETRS89 geographic coordinates))

---

- [Download the data as fiboa GeoParquet](https://data.source.coop/fiboa/es-md/es_md.parquet)
- [STAC Browser](https://radiantearth.github.io/stac-browser/#/external/data.source.coop/fiboa/es-md/stac/collection.json)
- [STAC Collection](https://data.source.coop/fiboa/es-md/stac/collection.json)
- [PMTiles](https://data.source.coop/fiboa/es-md/es_md.pmtiles)

## Columns

| Property               | **Data Type** | Description |

| crop:code              | string        |             |
| crop:name              | string        |             |

| area                   | float         |             |

## Lineage

- Data downloaded on 2024-12-29 from:

- Converted to GeoParquet using [fiboa-cli](https://github.com/fiboa/cli), version 0.8.0
